verdict.rationale: PlanetScale ships database branching: Vitess branches cover schemas for development (docs-9, docs-32), and Postgres branches are isolated dev/test deployments that can be restored from backups or to a point in time with --restore-point, which brings in production data (docs-10, docs-5). Nothing shows these branches are instant or copy-on-write; data comes through backup restore rather than a zero-copy fork. missing for 10: evidence of instant copy-on-write branching, documented schema-plus-data branching on Vitess, independent hands-on corroboration of branching with production data.
